s00E92B.name: Mario level collision, borders and water
summary: Per-frame Mario vs level interaction. Clears the contact flags, runs the tile collision (CODE_00EADB) for layer 2 (with its displacement
[$26]/[$28] applied to Mario) when [$5B] bit 7 is set, then for layer 1, unless [$185C] diverts to CODE_00EE1D.
Then handles the screen edges: side exits call SubSideExit; otherwise a solid left/right border keeps Mario 8 px inside, carrying him with
the scroll when scrolling is off. Being crushed ([$77] & $1C) or off the right edge kills Mario. Finally updates swimming ([$8A] water bits):
entering/leaving water, splashes, bubbles, and the Up+B jump out of the water.
Quirk: the BEQ at $00E9CA is redundant (BPL covers it). Several [$13xx]/[$8x] flags are hedged in the line comments.

s00EAB9.name: Data: wall-walk tables and slope tile list
summary: Small tables used by CODE_00EADB: DATA_00EAB9/00EABB/00EABD (indexed by wall-walk side, purpose unclear) and DATA_00EAC1,
a 26-byte list of tile numbers (probably slope tiles).

lines.00E92B: Reset Mario's collision and water flags (CODE_00EAA6)
lines.00E933: [$185C] set: run the alternate handler instead (CODE_00EE1D)
lines.00E936: Skip the tile collision, go to $00E98C
lines.00E946: / Bit 7 of [$5B] clear (layer 2 not solid): go to $00E978
lines.00E963: Check Mario against the tiles of layer 2 (CODE_00EADB)
lines.00E978: [$13EF] <<= 1 (probably moves the layer 2 result to bit 1)
lines.00E981: Bit 6 of [$5B] into the sign flag
lines.00E982: Bit 6 set: skip the layer 1 check, go to $00E98C
lines.00E989: Check Mario against the tiles of layer 1 (CODE_00EADB)
lines.00E98F: / [$1B96] = 0 (no side exit): go to the screen border check at $00E9A1
lines.00E99A: Below $FA (not at the right edge): go to $00E9FB
lines.00E99C: At the edge of a side exit level: leave the level (SubSideExit)
lines.00E9A5: / On-screen X >= $F0: past the right edge, go kill Mario ($00EA08)
lines.00E9AB: / Blocked left or right ([$77] & 3): skip the border check, go to $00E9FB
lines.00E9AF: Y = 0: test the right border first
lines.00E9B8: / Compare right border ([$1462] + $E8) with Mario X (16-bit)
lines.00E9BA: Equal: not past the border, go to $00E9C8
lines.00E9BC: Border < Mario X: past the right border, go to $00E9C8
lines.00E9CC: / Not past the border (zero or positive): go to $00E9FB (BEQ is redundant)
lines.00E9D5: / [$77] |= $80: Mario is touching the edge of the screen
lines.00E9EA: / ([$00] - Mario X speed) EOR [DATA_00E90E+Y] negative: skip, go to $00E9F6
lines.00E9EE: / Mario X speed = scroll speed (carried along with the screen)
lines.00E9F3: / [$13DA] = [$144E] (probably the fractional part of the carried speed)
lines.00E9F9: / [$77] |= [DATA_00E90A+Y]: blocked on the right ($01) or left ($02)
lines.00EA01: / [$77] & $1C <> $1C (not floor, ceiling and inside a block): go to $00EA0D
lines.00EA06: / [$1471] non-zero (on a sprite platform): not crushed, go to $00EA0D
lines.00EA08: Kill Mario: crushed or past the screen edge (CODE_00F629)
lines.00EA15: / Y = 0 if blocked on the right, 2 if blocked on the left
lines.00EA1E: / Mario X += [DATA_00E90D+Y]: push out of the wall by 1 pixel (-1 or +1)
lines.00EA24: / [$77] bit 7 (touching the screen edge) set: go to $00EA34
lines.00EA30: / X speed EOR [DATA_00E90D+Y] positive (moving away from the wall): go to $00EA34
lines.00EA3F: / If [RAM_IsBehindScenery] = 1 and [$8B] = 0 (probably no longer on a scenery tile), clear it
lines.00EA42: [$13FA] = 0 (probably the at-water-surface flag, set again below)
lines.00EA47: / Water level: Mario is always swimming, go to $00EA5E
lines.00EA4B: / [$8A] bit 0 (touching a water tile) clear: leave the water, go to $00EAA3
lines.00EA53: / Moving up (Y speed negative): go to $00EA65
lines.00EA57: / [$8A] bit 1 (probably fully submerged tile) clear: not in the water yet, return
lines.00EA5C: Mario Y speed = 0 on entering the water
lines.00EA62: Maybe spawn an air bubble (CODE_00FD08), then return
lines.00EA73: / Mario Y speed = max([Y speed], -4): limit upward speed at the surface
lines.00EA7E: / [$15] & $88 = $88 (B and Up held)? If not, go to $00EA62
lines.00EA8A: / [RAM_IsSpinJump] = 1: spin jump out of the water
lines.00EA96: / [$77] bit 3 (head blocked) set: cannot leave, go to $00EA62
lines.00EAA1: / Mario Y speed = $AA (-86): jump out of the water
lines.00EAB9: Table: $DE, $23 (speed values indexed by wall-walk side, purpose unclear)
